examples.chinese: 台灣夏天的天氣很熱，很多人都喜歡喝飲料。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xiàtiān de tiānqì hěn rè, hěn duō rén dōu xǐhuān hē yǐnliào.
examples.english: During summer the weather is very hot in Taiwan, many people like to have beverages.

examples.chinese: 妳胖了嗎？我不覺得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去買今年夏天的新衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pàng le ma? Wǒ bù juéde a, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù mǎi jīnnián xiàtiān de xīn yīfu.
examples.english: Have you gained weight? I don’t think so. I can go check with you. I would like to buy the new summer collections.

items.wordHook: 夏(summer) + 天(day) → the summer days are 夏天, meaning summer.

examples.chinese: 我家附近有三條捷運線，一條紅的、一條綠的和一條藍的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu sān tiáo jiéyùn xiàn, yì tiáo hóng de, yì tiáo lǜ de hé yì tiáo lán de.
examples.english: There are three MRT routes near my place; the red one, the green one and the blue one.

examples.chinese: 很好看。這條藍的也很漂亮，藍色是今年很流行的顏色。
examples.pinyin: Hěn hǎokàn. Zhè tiáo lán de yě hěn piàoliang, lánsè shì jīnnián hěn liúxíng de yánsè.
examples.english: It is. This pair of blue pants is beautiful too. Blue is a popular color of this year.

items.wordHook: a 艹(grass) dye rests under a 監(jiān) watch → the cloth turns deep 藍(blue).

examples.chinese: 因為他每天都跑步，所以瘦了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tā měitiān dōu pǎobù, suǒyǐ shòu le.
examples.english: Because he runs every day, he has become thin.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 聽說騎腳踏車可以讓大腿瘦一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō qí jiǎotàchē kěyǐ ràng dàtuǐ shòu yìdiǎnr.
examples.english: I've heard that riding a bicycle can make your thighs a little thinner.

items.wordHook: After a 疒(sickness) an 叟(old man) eats little → growing gaunt and 瘦(thin).

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 我常在網路上聽我喜歡的音樂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cháng zài wǎnglù shàng tīng wǒ xǐhuān de yīnyuè.
examples.english: I often listen to music I like on the internet.

examples.chinese: 這家咖啡館有免費的無線網路，我可以邊喝咖啡邊上網。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kāfēiguǎn yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù, wǒ kěyǐ biān hē kāfēi biān shàngwǎng.
examples.english: This café has free Wi-Fi; I can drink coffee while surfing the internet.

examples.chinese: 小馬先用手機把要賣的商品全部都拍了下來，再放到網路上賣，一個星期就賣完了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ xiān yòng shǒujī bǎ yào mài de shāngpǐn quánbù dōu pāi le xiàlái, zài fàng dào wǎnglù shàng mài, yī ge xīngqī jiù mài wán le.
examples.english: Xiao Ma first used his cell phone to photograph all the products he wanted to sell, then put them online to sell, and they were sold out in a week.

examples.chinese: 想要得到好成績，除了努力用功，還得學習怎麼利用網路資源。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào dédào hǎo chéngjī, chúle nǔlì yònggōng, hái děi xuéxí zěnme lìyòng wǎnglù zīyuán.
examples.english: If you want to get good grades, besides working hard, you also need to learn how to use online resources.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese: 現在的科技很進步，萬一迷了路，就可以利用網路地圖找到回家的路。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de kējì hěn jìnbù, wànyī mí le lù, jiù kěyǐ lìyòng wǎnglù dìtú zhǎo dào huí jiā de lù.
examples.english: Technology is very advanced now; in case you get lost, you can use online maps to find the way home.

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.
examples.english: A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人使用網路上課，所以手機、電腦也就變成了重要的學習工具。
examples.pinyin: Yuèláiyuè duō rén shǐyòng wǎnglù shàngkè, suǒyǐ shǒujī, diànnǎo yě jiù biànchéng le zhòngyào de xuéxí gōngjù.
examples.english: More and more people use the Internet for classes, so mobile phones and computers have also become important learning tools.

examples.chinese: 為了提供學生良好的學習環境，學校改善了教室的設備，網路的速度也變快了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígōng xuéshēng liánghǎo de xuéxí huánjìng, xuéxiào gǎishàn le jiàoshì de shèbèi, wǎnglù de sùdù yě biàn kuài le.
examples.english: In order to provide students with a good learning environment, the school improved the classroom equipment, and the internet speed also became faster.

examples.chinese: 王小姐用網路交友的方式，找到了理想的結婚對象。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě yòng wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì, zhǎodàole lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng.
examples.english: Miss Wang used the method of making friends online and found her ideal marriage partner.

examples.chinese: 他透過網路認識了一位網友，直到結婚前，他們才見過對方三次。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò wǎnglù rènshi le yī wèi wǎngyǒu, zhídào jiéhūn qián, tāmen cái jiàn guò duìfāng sān cì.
examples.english: He met an online friend through the Internet, and they had only seen each other three times before they got married.

examples.chinese: 那個網路商店經常賣假貨，你可別上當。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wǎnglù shāngdiàn jīngcháng mài jiǎhuò, nǐ kě bié shàngdàng.
examples.english: That online store often sells fake goods; you'd better not be tricked.

examples.chinese: 有了無線網路，就可以隨時隨地上網查資料、看影片，或是玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le wúxiàn wǎnglù, jiù kěyǐ suíshísuídì shàngwǎng chá zīliào, kàn yǐngpiàn, huòshì wán yóuxì.
examples.english: With wireless internet, you can go online anytime, anywhere to look up information, watch videos, or play games.

examples.chinese: 現代人往往以網路傳訊息，代替傳統寫信或打電話的方式。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén wǎngwǎng yǐ wǎnglù chuán xiāoxi, dàitì chuántǒng xiě xìn huò dǎ diànhuà de fāngshì.
examples.english: Modern people often use the internet to send messages, replacing the traditional ways of writing letters or making phone calls.

examples.chinese: 杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。
examples.pinyin: Dù xiānsheng shì sān jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de zhǔguǎn, tā xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng dà qǐyè de lǎobǎn, yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de shìyè.
examples.english: Mr. Du is the manager of three online stores; he hopes that in the future he can become the boss of a big enterprise and have his own career.

examples.chinese: 有一些網路上的資料或影片是被保護的，不能隨便下載。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē wǎnglù shàng de zīliào huò yǐngpiàn shì bèi bǎohù de, bùnéng suíbiàn xiàzài.
examples.english: Some materials or videos on the internet are protected and cannot be downloaded casually.

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 這本中文教材是網路書店出版的，你得上網才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn zhōngwén jiàocái shì wǎnglù shūdiàn chūbǎn de, nǐ děi shàngwǎng cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: This Chinese textbook is published by an online bookstore; you have to go online to be able to buy it.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 對現代人來說，電腦和網路絕對是辦公室的主要設備。
examples.pinyin: Duì xiàndài rén lái shuō, diànnǎo hé wǎnglù juéduì shì bàngōngshì de zhǔyào shèbèi.
examples.english: For modern people, computers and the internet are definitely the main equipment in the office.

examples.chinese: 只要打開手機，連上網路，就能立刻掌握全球新聞。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào dǎkāi shǒujī, liánshàng wǎnglù, jiù néng lìkè zhǎngwò quánqiú xīnwén.
examples.english: As long as you turn on your phone and connect to the internet, you can immediately grasp global news.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯透過網路、報紙，尋找三十年前因為戰爭而分開的家人，最後終於找到了。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo tòuguò wǎnglù, bàozhǐ, xúnzhǎo sānshí nián qián yīnwèi zhànzhēng ér fēnkāi de jiārén, zuìhòu zhōngyú zhǎodào le.
examples.english: Uncle Lin searched through the Internet and newspapers for family members separated thirty years ago because of war, and finally found them.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 在雲端科技發達的時代裡，人人都能夠透過網路交友、學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài yúnduān kējì fādá de shídài lǐ, rénrén dōu nénggòu tòuguò wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, xuéxí.
examples.english: In an era of advanced cloud technology, everyone can make friends and learn through the internet.

examples.chinese: 在這家網路書店購買商品，顧客得先匯款。一般購物網站都是等收到顧客的匯款後，才寄出商品的。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā wǎnglù shūdiàn gòumǎi shāngpǐn, gùkè děi xiān huìkuǎn. Yībān gòuwù wǎngzhàn dōu shì děng shōudào gùkè de huìkuǎn hòu, cái jìchū shāngpǐn de.
examples.english: To purchase products at this online bookstore, customers must first remit money. Generally, shopping websites all wait until they have received the customer's remittance before they send out the products.

examples.chinese: 我老婆最近又忙又累，因此我特地在餐桌上頭擺了她最愛的紅玫瑰，讓她開心一下。為了打開(to open up)國外市場，公司上頭決定增加網路銷售方面的經費。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lǎopo zuìjìn yòu máng yòu lèi, yīncǐ wǒ tèdì zài cānzhuō shàngtou bǎi le tā zuì ài de hóng méiguī, ràng tā kāixīn yīxià. Wèile dǎkāi guówài shìchǎng, gōngsī shàngtou juédìng zēngjiā wǎnglù xiāoshòu fāngmiàn de jīngfèi.
examples.english: My wife has been both busy and tired recently, so I specially placed her favorite red roses on top of the dining table to cheer her up a bit. In order to open up overseas markets, the company's higher-ups decided to increase funding for online sales.

examples.chinese: 在網路上，商品的交易雖然方便，但也應注意安全問題。許小姐知道社團網友想賣手機，就拿二手(second hand)筆電去交易，結果對方同意了。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù shàng, shāngpǐn de jiāoyì suīrán fāngbiàn, dàn yě yīng zhùyì ānquán wèntí. Xǔ xiǎojiě zhīdào shètuán wǎngyǒu xiǎng mài shǒujī, jiù ná èrshǒu bǐdiàn qù jiāoyì, jiéguǒ duìfāng tóngyì le.
examples.english: Online, although product transactions are convenient, you should also pay attention to safety issues. Miss Xu knew that a club netizen wanted to sell a cell phone, so she took a second-hand laptop to trade, and the other party agreed.

examples.chinese: 如果你是那家網路商店的會員，購買任何商品都可以便宜兩成。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ shì nà jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de huìyuán, gòumǎi rènhé shāngpǐn dōu kěyǐ piányi liǎng chéng.
examples.english: If you are a member of that online store, you can buy any product for twenty percent cheaper.

examples.chinese: 網路直播的內容各種各樣，甚至有人因為直播平日生活而變成明星。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhíbō de nèiróng gèzhǒng-gèyàng, shènzhì yǒu rén yīnwèi zhíbō píngrì shēnghuó ér biànchéng míngxīng.
examples.english: The content of live internet broadcasts is all kinds of things; some people even become stars because they live-broadcast their everyday life.

examples.chinese: 雖然現在網路很普遍了，還是有不少人喜歡聽電臺的節目。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán xiànzài wǎnglù hěn pǔbiàn le, hái shì yǒu bùshǎo rén xǐhuān tīng diàntái de jiémù.
examples.english: Although the internet is very common now, there are still quite a few people who like to listen to radio station programs.

examples.chinese: 我的電腦無法上網，檢查之後才發現網路線沒有接著電腦。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo wúfǎ shàngwǎng, jiǎnchá zhīhòu cái fāxiàn wǎnglùxiàn méiyǒu jiēzhe diànnǎo.
examples.english: My computer can't get online; only after checking did I discover that the network cable was not connected to the computer.

examples.chinese: 個人在使用各式各樣的網路服務時，也應該注意隱私問題。
examples.pinyin: Gèrén zài shǐyòng gè shì gè yàng de wǎnglù fúwù shí, yě yīnggāi zhùyì yǐnsī wèntí.
examples.english: When individuals use various kinds of internet services, they should also pay attention to privacy issues.

examples.chinese: 他想成為網路作家，不過擔心將來的收入可能不穩定。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chéngwéi wǎnglù zuòjiā, bùguò dānxīn jiānglái de shōurù kěnéng bù wěndìng.
examples.english: He wants to become an online writer, but worries that his future income may be unstable.

examples.chinese: 她到印尼買了一些木頭做的禮品，加工後再到網路上售出。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào Yìnní mǎi le yīxiē mùtou zuò de lǐpǐn, jiāgōng hòu zài dào wǎnglù shàng shòuchū.
examples.english: She went to Indonesia and bought some gifts made of wood; after processing them, she then sold them online.

examples.chinese: 網路商店時常在過節時舉辦降價活動來吸引顧客。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn shícháng zài guòjié shí jǔbàn jiàngjià huódòng lái xīyǐn gùkè.
examples.english: Online stores often hold discount events during festivals to attract customers.

examples.chinese: 由於網路發達，現代人大都習慣上網購物。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú wǎnglù fādá, xiàndài rén dàdōu xíguàn shàngwǎng gòuwù.
examples.english: Due to the development of the Internet, modern people for the most part are accustomed to shopping online.

examples.chinese: 網路購物辦理退貨時，必須保持商品原來的外觀才行。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù gòuwù bànlǐ tuìhuò shí, bìxū bǎochí shāngpǐn yuánlái de wàiguān cái xíng.
examples.english: When returning items purchased online, you must keep the product's original appearance.

items.wordHook: 網(net) + 路(road) → the net of roads: 網路 is the internet.

examples.chinese: 今天下午學校有籃球比賽，我們去看吧！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù kàn ba!
examples.english: There is a basketball game at school this afternoon. Let’s go watch it!

examples.chinese: 我朋友最近比較忙，別的時間他沒有空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu zuìjìn bǐjiào máng, biéde shíjiān tā méi yǒukòng.
examples.english: My friend is busier lately; he isn’t available at other times.

items.wordHook: a 匕(spoon) lies beside another spoon → one is sweeter 比(than) the other.

examples.chinese: 請把洗衣機放在這邊，冰箱放在那邊。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ xǐyījī fàng zài zhèbiān, bīngxiāng fàng zài nàbiān.
examples.english: Please put the washing machine here and the refrigerator there.

examples.chinese: 我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo. Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english: I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good. My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese: 因為冰箱壞了，裡面的食物除了雞蛋、蘋果，其他的都腐敗了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi bīngxiāng huài le, lǐmiàn de shíwù chúle jīdàn, píngguǒ, qítā de dōu fǔbài le.
examples.english: Because the refrigerator broke, the food inside, except for the eggs and apples, all rotted.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 冰箱裡的牛奶早就過期了，你還不扔掉嗎？
examples.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ de niúnǎi zǎo jiù guòqī le, nǐ hái bù rēngdiào ma?
examples.english: The milk in the fridge expired long ago—aren't you going to throw it away yet?

examples.chinese: 月亮上面沒有動物，這是1969年科學的新發現。
examples.pinyin: Yuèliang shàngmiàn méiyǒu dòngwù, zhè shì 1969 nián kēxué de xīn fāxiàn.
examples.english: There are no animals on the moon; this is a new scientific discovery of 1969.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"參加社團活動，是讓自己成長的好機會。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"孩子出國留學以後，父母發現孩子成長了不少。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng, shì ràng zìjǐ chéngzhǎng de hǎo jīhuì. Háizi chūguó liúxué yǐhòu, fùmǔ fāxiàn háizi chéngzhǎng le bùshǎo.
examples.english: Participating in club activities is a good opportunity for personal growth. After their child went abroad to study, the parents found that the child had grown a lot.

examples.chinese: 我發現他的生肖跟我一樣，都是屬牛的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn tā de shēngxiào gēn wǒ yīyàng, dōu shì shǔ niú de.
examples.english: I found out that his Chinese zodiac sign is the same as mine—we are both born in the Year of the Ox.

examples.chinese: 上次出國時，到了機場才發現沒帶護照，這次我絕對不會再忘了。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì chūguó shí, dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn méi dài hùzhào, zhè cì wǒ juéduì bù huì zài wàng le.
examples.english: Last time I went abroad, I only discovered at the airport that I hadn't brought my passport; this time I absolutely will not forget again.

examples.chinese: A:要是你發現男朋友對你越來越冷淡，還常跟女網友約會， 你會原諒他嗎？ B:這麼花心的男人，絕對不值得原諒。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàoshi nǐ fāxiàn nánpéngyou duì nǐ yuèláiyuè lěngdàn, hái cháng gēn nǚ wǎngyǒu yuēhuì, nǐ huì yuánliàng tā ma? B: Zhème huāxīn de nánrén, juéduì bù zhídé yuánliàng.
examples.english: A: If you found out that your boyfriend was becoming colder and colder toward you and often went on dates with female internet friends, would you forgive him? B: A man who is such a playboy is absolutely not worth forgiving.

examples.chinese: 史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎnchá guo hǎojǐ cì, háishi bèi tā fāxiàn le jǐ ge cuòzì.
examples.english: Ms. Shi is very careful in her work; I checked this form several times, but she still found a few typos.

examples.chinese: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english: Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 有幾位學生的期中考沒考好，教授要他們下星期補考。出門上班前，我才發現短裙破了，不得不先補號再去上班，結果就遲到了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu jǐ wèi xuéshēng de qīzhōngkǎo méi kǎo hǎo, jiàoshòu yào tāmen xià xīngqī bǔkǎo. Chūmén shàngbān qián, wǒ cái fāxiàn duǎnqún pò le, bùdébù xiān bǔ hǎo zài qù shàngbān, jiéguǒ jiù chídào le.
examples.english: Several students didn't do well on the midterm exam, so the professor wants them to take a make-up exam next week. Before going out to work, I discovered that my skirt was torn, and I had no choice but to mend it first before going to work, and as a result, I was late.

examples.chinese: 拿到購物收據，要是發現算錯帳了，就請店員再算一次。
examples.pinyin: Ná dào gòuwù shōujù, yàoshi fāxiàn suàn cuò zhàng le, jiù qǐng diànyuán zài suàn yí cì.
examples.english: When you get the shopping receipt, if you find that the bill has been calculated wrong, ask the clerk to calculate it again.

examples.chinese: 他在超市隨手買了瓶飲料，回家後才發現有效日期快到了，只好趕快喝完。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài chāoshì suíshǒu mǎi le píng yǐnliào, huí jiā hòu cái fāxiàn yǒuxiào rìqī kuài dào le, zhǐhǎo gǎnkuài hē wán.
examples.english: He conveniently bought a bottle of drink at the supermarket, and only after getting home did he discover that the expiration date was almost up, so he had no choice but to hurry and finish drinking it.

examples.chinese: 我的電腦無法上網，檢查之後才發現網路線沒有接著電腦。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo wúfǎ shàngwǎng, jiǎnchá zhīhòu cái fāxiàn wǎnglùxiàn méiyǒu jiēzhe diànnǎo.
examples.english: My computer can't get online; only after checking did I discover that the network cable was not connected to the computer.

examples.chinese: 媽媽發現嬰兒尿得整件內褲都是尿，就幫他換了新的。
examples.pinyin: Māma fāxiàn yīng'ér niào de zhěng jiàn nèikù dōu shì niào, jiù bāng tā huànle xīn de.
examples.english: The mother discovered that the baby had urinated so much that his whole underwear was full of urine, so she helped him change into new ones.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，目前已被發現的蝴蝶大約有三百七十種以上。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, mùqián yǐ bèi fāxiàn de húdié dàyuē yǒu sānbǎi qīshí zhǒng yǐshàng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the butterflies that have been discovered so far number approximately over 370 species.

examples.chinese: 小安現在的健康情況很差，就算很想參加網球比賽，恐怕也贏不了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān xiànzài de jiànkāng qíngkuàng hěn chà, jiùsuàn hěn xiǎng cānjiā wǎngqiú bǐsài, kǒngpà yě yíng bùliǎo.
examples.english: Xiao'an's current health condition is very poor. Even if he really wants to participate in the tennis match, I'm afraid he won't be able to win.

examples.chinese: 金小姐穿上這件淺色的上衣， 看起來更年輕、更有精神了。這個衣櫃有點兒淺，這件厚大衣掛不進去，就算掛進去了， 門也關不起來。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiǎojiě chuān shàng zhè jiàn qiǎnsè de shàngyī, kàn qǐlái gèng niánqīng, gèng yǒu jīngshén le. Zhège yīguì yǒudiǎnr qiǎn, zhè jiàn hòu dàyī guà bù jìnqù, jiùsuàn guà jìnqù le, mén yě guān bù qǐlái.
examples.english: When Miss Jin puts on this light-colored top, she looks younger and more energetic. This wardrobe is a bit shallow; this thick coat can't hang inside, and even if it could, the door wouldn't close.

examples.chinese: 我最喜歡的休閒活動是爬山和露營。為了身體和心理的健康，就算再忙，假日也應該休閒一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiūxián huódòng shì páshān hé lùyíng. Wèile shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng, jiùsuàn zài máng, jiàrì yě yīnggāi xiūxián yīxià.
examples.english: My favorite leisure activities are mountain climbing and camping. For the sake of physical and mental health, even if you're busy, you should still take some leisure time on holidays.

examples.chinese: 歐先生有閱讀的障礙，就算一篇極短的文章，讀起來也覺得很困難。
examples.pinyin: Ōu xiānsheng yǒu yuèdú de zhàng'ài, jiùsuàn yī piān jí duǎn de wénzhāng, dú qǐlái yě juéde hěn kùnnán.
examples.english: Mr. Ou has a reading obstacle; even a very short article feels difficult for him to read.

examples.chinese: 方老師非常有耐心，就算學生考試的成績很糟，也從來沒發過脾氣。
examples.pinyin: Fāng lǎoshī fēicháng yǒu nàixīn, jiùsuàn xuéshēng kǎoshì de chéngjī hěn zāo, yě cónglái méi fā guo píqì.
examples.english: Teacher Fang is very patient; even if the students' exam scores are very bad, she has never lost her temper.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 心裡很平靜(peaceful)的人，就算居住在人車又多又吵的市區，仍然覺得自在。
examples.pinyin: Xīnlǐ hěn píngjìng de rén, jiùsuàn jūzhù zài rén chē yòu duō yòu chǎo de shìqū, réngrán juéde zìzài.
examples.english: People who are very peaceful inside, even if they live in an urban district with many people and cars and lots of noise, still feel at ease.

examples.chinese: 人與人之間的感情很珍貴，就算擁有再多的錢也買不到。
examples.pinyin: Rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de gǎnqíng hěn zhēnguì, jiùsuàn yōngyǒu zài duō de qián yě mǎi bù dào.
examples.english: The affection between people is very precious; even if you have a lot of money, you can't buy it.

examples.chinese: 一家餐廳要是受歡迎，就算把店關在郊區的某個小巷子裡，也還是時常客滿。
examples.pinyin: Yī jiā cāntīng yàoshi shòu huānyíng, jiùsuàn bǎ diàn guān zài jiāoqū de mǒu ge xiǎo xiàngzi lǐ, yě háishì shícháng kèmǎn.
examples.english: If a restaurant is popular, even if it is tucked away in a small alley in the suburbs, it will still often be full of customers.

examples.chinese: 這部電影一點兒都不吸引人，就算錯過了也無所謂。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng yīdiǎnr dōu bù xīyǐn rén, jiùsuàn cuòguò le yě wúsuǒwèi.
examples.english: This movie is not attractive at all; even if you miss it, it doesn't matter.

examples.chinese: 如果你亂吃垃圾食品，就算按時運動，體重也很難減輕。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ luàn chī lājī shípǐn, jiùsuàn ànshí yùndòng, tǐzhòng yě hěn nán jiǎnqīng.
examples.english: If you eat junk food indiscriminately, even if you exercise on time, it will still be very hard to lose weight.

examples.chinese: 有能力的人就算不幸失業了，將來還是有許多機會等待著他。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu nénglì de rén jiùsuàn bùxìng shīyè le, jiānglái háishì yǒu xǔduō jīhuì děngdàizhe tā.
examples.english: Even if capable people unfortunately lose their jobs, there are still many opportunities waiting for them in the future.

examples.chinese: 就算擁有高收入，也不見得能讓你過著幸福美好的生活。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn yōngyǒu gāo shōurù, yě bújiàndé néng ràng nǐ guòzhe xìngfú měihǎo de shēnghuó.
examples.english: Even if you have a high income, it does not necessarily mean you can live a happy and wonderful life.

examples.chinese: 就算沒有很高的學位，只要用心一樣能對國家社會有貢獻。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn méiyǒu hěn gāo de xuéwèi, zhǐyào yòngxīn yīyàng néng duì guójiā shèhuì yǒu gòngxiàn.
examples.english: Even without a high academic degree, as long as you are dedicated, you can still contribute to the country and society.

examples.chinese: 現代人生活忙碌，就算是好友也偶然才碰面聊聊。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén shēnghuó mánglù, jiùsuàn shì hǎoyǒu yě ǒurán cái pèngmiàn liáoliao.
examples.english: Modern people are busy with life; even good friends only meet occasionally to chat.

examples.chinese: 樂觀的人會積極挑戰困難，就算無法成功也不會感到失望。
examples.pinyin: Lèguān de rén huì jījí tiǎozhàn kùnnán, jiùsuàn wúfǎ chénggōng yě bù huì gǎndào shīwàng.
examples.english: Optimistic people will actively challenge difficulties; even if they cannot succeed, they will not feel disappointed.

items.wordHook: Combining 就(approach) and 算(calculate): 就算 means even if, granted that.

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese: 要是你想出國留學，一定得加強外語能力。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ xiǎng chūguó liúxué, yídìng děi jiāqiáng wàiyǔ nénglì.
examples.english: If you want to study abroad, you definitely have to strengthen your foreign language ability.

examples.chinese: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

items.wordHook: Stepping forward to 出(go out) and contribute all your physical 力(strength): 出力 means share one's strength or power.

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

items.wordHook: Combining 以(according to) and 下(below): 以下 means below, under.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方很偏僻，手機常收不到訊息，朋友很難跟我聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng hěn piānpì, shǒujī cháng shōu bù dào xùnxí, péngyǒu hěn nán gēn wǒ liánluò.
examples.english: The place I live is very remote; my phone often can't receive information, and it's hard for friends to contact me.

examples.chinese: 我等一下要開會，不方便接電話，有事就用手機傳訊息給我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng yīxià yào kāihuì, bù fāngbiàn jiē diànhuà, yǒu shì jiù yòng shǒujī chuán xùnxí gěi wǒ.
examples.english: I have a meeting in a little while, so it's not convenient to answer the phone; if there's anything, just send me a message on my cell phone.

examples.chinese: 現代人往往以網路傳訊息，代替傳統寫信或打電話的方式。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén wǎngwǎng yǐ wǎnglù chuán xiāoxi, dàitì chuántǒng xiě xìn huò dǎ diànhuà de fāngshì.
examples.english: Modern people often use the internet to send messages, replacing the traditional ways of writing letters or making phone calls.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 我們應該培養獨立思考的能力，別被身邊各種訊息左右。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi péiyǎng dúlì sīkǎo de nénglì, bié bèi shēnbiān gèzhǒng xùnxī zuǒyòu.
examples.english: We should cultivate the ability to think independently; don't be controlled by all kinds of information around you.

items.wordHook: Combining 訊(news) and 息(end): 訊息 means information.

examples.chinese: 你知道第一次世界運動會是在哪裡舉行的嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào dì yī cì shìjiè yùndònghuì shì zài nǎlǐ jǔxíng de ma?
examples.english: Do you know where the first World Games were held?

examples.chinese: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.
examples.english: Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late.

examples.chinese: 阿姨的婚禮明天下午兩點在教堂舉行，這個重要時刻我一定不能遲到。
examples.pinyin: Āyí de hūnlǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn zài jiàotáng jǔxíng, zhège zhòngyào shíkè wǒ yīdìng bùnéng chídào.
examples.english: Auntie's wedding will be held at the church at two o'clock tomorrow afternoon; I absolutely must not be late for this important moment.

examples.chinese: 大型體育活動常選擇在都市舉行，主要原因是交通方便。
examples.pinyin: Dàxíng tǐyù huódòng cháng xuǎnzé zài dūshì jǔxíng, zhǔyào yuányīn shì jiāotōng fāngbiàn.
examples.english: Large-scale sports events are often chosen to be held in cities; the main reason is convenient transportation.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 你忙不過來的時候就該找人幫忙，別讓自己累壞了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ máng bú guòlái de shíhou jiù gāi zhǎo rén bāngmáng, bié ràng zìjǐ lèihuài le.
examples.english: When you are too busy to manage, you should find someone to help; don't let yourself get exhausted.

examples.chinese: 幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
examples.pinyin: 1. Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái. 2. Xìngkuī wǒ bǎ zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàobùrán zhǎo bú dào suíshēndié, zěnme kāihuì ne?
examples.english: 1. Thanks to your help, otherwise I definitely wouldn't be able to handle it alone. 2. Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?

items.wordHook: Too 忙(busy) with tasks to 不(not) let deadlines 過(pass) as orders 來(arrive): 忙不過來 means too busy to manage.

examples.chinese: 老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān bǎ gēn kèchéng xiāngguān de xuéxí zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí.
examples.english: The teacher first uploads the course-related learning materials to the cloud for students to preview.

items.wordHook: Combining 預(prepare) and 習(study): 預習 means preview.

examples.chinese: 上週末我們去爬山，走到半路時忽然吹起大風來，害我們不得不下山。
examples.pinyin: Shàng zhōumò wǒmen qù páshān, zǒu dào bànlù shí hūrán chuī qǐ dàfēng lái, hài wǒmen bùdébù xiàshān.
examples.english: Last weekend we went mountain climbing, and when we had walked halfway, suddenly a strong wind started blowing, which forced us to have to go down the mountain.

examples.chinese: 他願意挑戰自己的工作能力，並積極地克服挫折，真是難得。
examples.pinyin: Tā yuànyì tiǎozhàn zìjǐ de gōngzuò nénglì, bìng jījí de kèfú cuòzhé, zhēn shì nándé.
examples.english: He is willing to challenge his own work abilities and actively overcome setbacks; that is truly rare.

examples.chinese: 在大都市，早上起床能聽見鳥叫聲，那真是太難得了。
examples.pinyin: Zài dà dūshì, zǎoshang qǐchuáng néng tīngjiàn niǎo jiào shēng, nà zhēn shì tài nándé le.
examples.english: In a big city, being able to hear the sound of birds chirping when you get up in the morning is truly rare.

examples.chinese: 難得出國旅行，一定要多照幾張相片留念。
examples.pinyin: Nándé chūguó lǚxíng, yīdìng yào duō zhào jǐ zhāng xiàngpiàn liúniàn.
examples.english: It is rare to travel abroad, so you must take a few more photos to keep as souvenirs.

examples.chinese: 難得今天有空，我們不如一口氣解決工作上所有的問題吧。
examples.pinyin: Nándé jīntiān yǒu kòng, wǒmen bùrú yìkǒuqì jiějué gōngzuò shàng suǒyǒu de wèntí ba.
examples.english: It's rare to have free time today; why don't we solve all the work problems in one go.

examples.chinese: 上星期電視臺的人來訪問我們，請我們談談學習華語的經驗。
examples.pinyin: Shàng xīngqī diànshìtái de rén lái fǎngwèn wǒmen, qǐng wǒmen tán tan xuéxí Huáyǔ de jīngyàn.
examples.english: Last week people from the TV station came to interview us, asking us to talk about our experience learning Chinese.

examples.chinese: 電視臺常在熱門比賽的轉播中放一些廣告，靠這種方式來賺錢。
examples.pinyin: Diànshìtái cháng zài rèmén bǐsài de zhuǎnbō zhōng fàng yīxiē guǎnggào, kào zhè zhǒng fāngshì lái zhuànqián.
examples.english: TV stations often place some advertisements during the broadcast of popular matches, relying on this method to make money.

examples.chinese: 電視臺播出的娛樂節目多半是唱歌跳舞的表演，能讓觀眾心情愉快。
examples.pinyin: Diànshìtái bōchū de yúlè jiémù duōbàn shì chànggē tiàowǔ de biǎoyǎn, néng ràng guānzhòng xīnqíng yúkuài.
examples.english: Most of the entertainment programs broadcast by TV stations are singing and dancing performances, which can make the audience feel happy.

examples.chinese: 昨天電視臺的氣象報告說今天會下雨，果然一大早就下起雨來了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān diànshìtái de qìxiàng bàogào shuō jīntiān huì xiàyǔ, guǒrán yí dàzǎo jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le.
examples.english: Yesterday the TV station's weather report said it would rain today, and just as expected, it started raining early in the morning.

examples.chinese: 根據規定，每位旅客只能攜帶一件七公斤以下的行李上飛機。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù guīdìng, měi wèi lǚkè zhǐ néng xiédài yí jiàn qī gōngjīn yǐxià de xíngli shàng fēijī.
examples.english: According to regulations, each traveler can only carry one piece of luggage under seven kilograms onto the plane.

examples.chinese: 為了旅客搭機安全，機場入境、出境時都要檢查行李。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le lǚkè dā jī ānquán, jīchǎng rùjìng, chūjìng shí dōu yào jiǎnchá xínglǐ.
examples.english: For passenger flight safety, luggage must be checked when entering and leaving the country at the airport.

examples.chinese: 班機起飛前，服務人員都會為旅客說明應注意的安全規定。
examples.pinyin: Bānjī qǐfēi qián, fúwù rényuán dōu huì wèi lǚkè shuōmíng yīng zhùyì de ānquán guīdìng.
examples.english: Before the flight takes off, the service staff will explain the safety regulations that should be noted to the passengers.

examples.chinese: 這個旅行團的目的地是中國北京(Beijing)，旅客目的是參觀古蹟及拜訪朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǚxíngtuán de mùdìdì shì Zhōngguó Běijīng, lǚkè mùdì shì cānguān gǔjì jí bàifǎng péngyǒu.
examples.english: The destination of this tour group is Beijing, China; the travelers' purpose is to visit historical sites and visit friends.

examples.chinese: 坐火車時，一旁的旅客不停地講電話，吵得我受不了。
examples.pinyin: Zuò huǒchē shí, yīpáng de lǚkè bùtíng de jiǎng diànhuà, chǎo de wǒ shòubuliǎo.
examples.english: When I was on the train, the passenger beside me kept talking on the phone, making such a noise that I couldn't stand it.

examples.chinese: 我明天要把這份作業交給老師，遲了老師就不收了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào bǎ zhè fèn zuòyè jiāo gěi lǎoshī, chí le lǎoshī jiù bù shōu le.
examples.english: I need to hand this homework to the teacher tomorrow; if it's late, the teacher won't accept it.

examples.chinese: 我的同事遲到的次數太多了，這個月被扣了半個月的薪水。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngshì chídào de cìshù tài duō le, zhè ge yuè bèi kòu le bàn ge yuè de xīnshuǐ.
examples.english: My colleague has been late too many times; this month half a month's salary was deducted.

examples.chinese: 要是你每天都坐在電腦前，不起來運動運動，遲早會生病的。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ měitiān dōu zuò zài diànnǎo qián, bù qǐlái yùndòng yùndòng, chízǎo huì shēngbìng de.
examples.english: If you sit in front of the computer every day and don't get up to exercise, sooner or later you will get sick.

examples.chinese: 開會時他遲到了，只好悄悄地坐在會議室後面。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì shí tā chídào le, zhǐhǎo qiāoqiāo de zuò zài huìyìshì hòumiàn.
examples.english: He was late for the meeting, so he had no choice but to quietly sit at the back of the conference room.

examples.chinese: 有幾位學生的期中考沒考好，教授要他們下星期補考。出門上班前，我才發現短裙破了，不得不先補號再去上班，結果就遲到了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu jǐ wèi xuéshēng de qīzhōngkǎo méi kǎo hǎo, jiàoshòu yào tāmen xià xīngqī bǔkǎo. Chūmén shàngbān qián, wǒ cái fāxiàn duǎnqún pò le, bùdébù xiān bǔ hǎo zài qù shàngbān, jiéguǒ jiù chídào le.
examples.english: Several students didn't do well on the midterm exam, so the professor wants them to take a make-up exam next week. Before going out to work, I discovered that my skirt was torn, and I had no choice but to mend it first before going to work, and as a result, I was late.

examples.chinese: 你上班別遲到，小心公司扣你的錢！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shàngbān bié chídào, xiǎoxīn gōngsī kòu nǐ de qián!
examples.english: Don't be late for work; be careful the company might dock your pay!

examples.chinese: 阿姨的婚禮明天下午兩點在教堂舉行，這個重要時刻我一定不能遲到。
examples.pinyin: Āyí de hūnlǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn zài jiàotáng jǔxíng, zhège zhòngyào shíkè wǒ yīdìng bùnéng chídào.
examples.english: Auntie's wedding will be held at the church at two o'clock tomorrow afternoon; I absolutely must not be late for this important moment.

examples.chinese: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.
examples.english: Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late.

examples.chinese: 黃先生上班常遲到，也不認真工作，這樣的態度讓老闆很不滿。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng shàngbān cháng chídào, yě bù rènzhēn gōngzuò, zhèyàng de tàidù ràng lǎobǎn hěn bùmǎn.
examples.english: Mr. Huang is often late for work and does not work seriously; this kind of attitude makes the boss very dissatisfied.

examples.chinese: 你上班老是遲到，老闆不生氣嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shàngbān lǎoshì chídào, lǎobǎn bù shēngqì ma?
examples.english: You are always late for work; isn't your boss angry?

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"他常常遲到，讓老闆很生氣。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"弟弟的房間又髒又亂，已經三個月沒打掃了，所以媽媽生他的氣。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Tā chángcháng chídào, ràng lǎobǎn hěn shēngqì. / Dìdi de fángjiān yòu zāng yòu luàn, yǐjīng sān ge yuè méi dǎsǎo le, suǒyǐ māma shēng tā de qì.
examples.english: He is often late, which makes his boss very angry. / Younger brother's room is both dirty and messy; it has been three months since it was cleaned, so mom is angry at him.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"林小姐弄錯了約會的時間，所以遲到了半個小時。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"我覺得「害怕」跟「可怕」的意思差不多，所以常弄錯。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě nòngcuò le yuēhuì de shíjiān, suǒyǐ chídào le bàn ge xiǎoshí. Wǒ juéde “hàipà” gēn “kěpà” de yìsi chàbuduō, suǒyǐ cháng nòngcuò.
examples.english: Miss Lin made a mistake about the appointment time, so she was half an hour late. I think “afraid” and “scary” have similar meanings, so I often misunderstand.

examples.chinese: 我到公車站的時候，剛好有一班公車來了，要不然上班就遲到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào gōngchēzhàn de shíhou, gānghǎo yǒu yì bān gōngchē lái le, yàobùrán shàngbān jiù chídào le.
examples.english: When I got to the bus stop, a bus happened to arrive; otherwise I would have been late for work.

examples.chinese: 今天是我第一天上班，當然不能遲到。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ dì yī tiān shàngbān, dāngrán bù néng chídào.
examples.english: Today is my first day at work; of course I can't be late.

examples.chinese: 你打電話給我的時候，我在睡覺，還沒起來。妹妹昨天太晚睡，今天起不來，所以上課遲到了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ de shíhou, wǒ zài shuìjiào, hái méi qǐlái. Mèimei zuótiān tài wǎn shuì, jīntiān qǐ bù lái, suǒyǐ shàngkè chídào le.
examples.english: When you called me, I was sleeping and hadn't gotten up yet. My younger sister went to bed too late yesterday and couldn't get up today, so she was late for class.

examples.chinese: 不好意思，我遲到了。
examples.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ chídào le.
examples.english: I'm sorry, I'm late.

examples.chinese: 他今天上班遲到了，老闆不太高興。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān shàngbān chídào le, lǎobǎn bú tài gāoxìng.
examples.english: He was late for work today; the boss is not too happy.

examples.chinese: 有些事忍耐一下就過去了，什麼都想以吵架的方式解決，遲早會出事的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì rěnnài yīxià jiù guòqù le, shénme dōu xiǎng yǐ chǎojià de fāngshì jiějué, chízǎo huì chūshì de.
examples.english: Some things pass after enduring them for a bit; if you want to solve everything by arguing, sooner or later there will be an accident.

examples.chinese: 申請留學的過程中，最讓人操心的可能就是寫讀書計畫了。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng liúxué de guòchéng zhōng, zuì ràng rén cāoxīn de kěnéng jiù shì xiě dúshū jìhuà le.
examples.english: In the process of applying to study abroad, what worries people the most is probably writing the study plan.

examples.chinese: 我的親戚是數學教授，每次我有這方面的問題就向他請教。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qīnqi shì shùxué jiàoshòu, měi cì wǒ yǒu zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí jiù xiàng tā qǐngjiào.
examples.english: My relative is a math professor; every time I have a question in this area, I consult him.

examples.chinese: 假如擔心弄丟重要的資料，可複製一份存在電腦裡。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú dānxīn nòngdiū zhòngyào de zīliào, kě fùzhì yī fèn cún zài diànnǎo lǐ.
examples.english: If you are worried about losing important data, you can make a copy and save it on the computer.

examples.chinese: 這幅名畫每日吸引了上千位遊客前來博物館欣賞。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú míng huà měi rì xīyǐn le shàng qiān wèi yóukè qiánlái bówùguǎn xīnshǎng.
examples.english: This famous painting attracts over a thousand tourists each day to come to the museum to admire it.

items.wordHook: Combining 最(most) and 佳(good): 最佳 means the best, optimum, ideal.
an 上(above) sign rests with a 卜(divination) mark → one stamped 卡(card).
a 口(mouth) tastes a 非(Africa) bean → 啡(coffee).
A big person (大) is an adult (大人).
Combining 建(build) and 設(build): 建設 means build.
a 雚(heron) calls through every 欠(lack) → still 歡(happy).
Combining 況(condition) and 且(moreover): 況且 means furthermore.
Combining 淡(light) and 水(water): 淡水 means Danshui.
an 目(eye) rests as the lids 垂(hang) low → drifting to 睡(sleep).
The 糹(silk) threads reach 各(each) crossing, and the woven net is a 絡(web).
With a curved trunk like a 𠂊(bound hand) raised over a wide mouth and heavy 豕(pig) body, the gentle 象(elephant) strolls.
進(advance) + 步(step) → advancing a step: 進步 means to improve.
Examining the dental wear on an animal 齒(teeth) under a royal 令(command) determines its exact 齡(age).
